postprocessing: Selected original PNGs copied into the project; no raster retouching or resizing. Placement/scaling is performed by existing renderers.

assets.prompt: Stylized-concept. Finished top-down RPG interior map for RiftMon. Restrained crisp DS-era pixel art, warm wood, navy and gold. One large round dark-teal card table in the centre, four compact chairs, a few cards, wall shelves, lamps and two lake windows. Orthographic three-quarter overhead; 7:5, 28 by 20 tile layout: outer walls; top wall ends at row 5; floor columns 3–24, rows 6–17; table columns 10–17, rows 7–12; clear side aisles; small upper-right counter for an NPC; one bottom-centre exit, columns 13–14, to a dark corridor. Compact furniture matching large-headed one-tile-wide, two-tile-high sprites. No people, Pokémon, text or UI. Avoid painterly microdetail.

No people, creatures, table, chairs, text or UI.
